Title: [lsj] question: increased strength after superior Immortal Grapple?

Messages.Author: dancingmummy
Messages.Body:
Situation:

Agatha is in combat.
Round 1, close range, Agatha plays superior Immortal Grapple.
Determine Range step will be skipped on Round 2. Agatha successfully
presses to Round 2.

Round 2. Agatha's controller has top-decked an Increased Strength,
playable only before range is chosen.

Question:
Is Agatha's controller unable to play the Increased Strength in the
second round of combat? Since there is no "Determine Range" step, is
there no "before range is determined" step?

thanks in advance,
dancingmummy

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"dancingmummy" <mummydi...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:704f42d0.03082...@posting.google.com...


he is able to do so : there is no "determine range step", technically, but
there is still a window for "at the beginning of the round of combat" stuff.
Increased strength is played before range is chosen , so it falls in this
"at the beginning of the round" category ;)

Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
> Negative questions are problematic in English, yes.
> The hypothesis that there is no "before range is determined" step is
not true.

So Salem is right and you CAN play an Increased STR or whatever other
before range is determined cards even if you do skip that phase.
This question came up quite a few times now, mainly associated with High
Ground, Sniper Rifle and Storm Sewers.

Maybe the rulebook deserves an update on this?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The ruling has existed since [RTR 03-SEP-1994]: skipping the determine range
step doesn't mean that the "before range is determined" step is skipped.
